newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST - Electrolux Q1 profit seen at 910 mln skr.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Electrolux Q1 profit seen at 910 mln skr.

text.p: The first quarter profit after financial items at Swedish household appliance maker AB Electrolux is expected to rise to an average 910 million crowns, a Reuters poll of 10 analysts showed on Friday.
The group made a 1996 first quarter profit of 901 million crowns. Forecasts range from 705 million crowns to 1.05 billion crowns.
For the full year, analysts expect a profit after financial items of 3.92 billion crowns, compared with 3.25 billion crowns in the whole of 1996.
The analysts interviewed came from BZW, Carnegie, Foreningsbanken, Handelsbanken, Matteus, Morgan Grenfell, Myrberg & Wiklund, Paribas, Penser, S-E-Banken and Swedbank.
